That varies a lot. The parcel company probably has the biggest fleet—hundreds, maybe? They’re always expanding. The hospital one is smaller, maybe a dozen or so. The inspection firm is somewhere in between, but I don’t track exact numbers.

What matters more is how many drones are flying at once near a site. Some sites get busy, and if too many drones try to take off or land at the same time, we have to slow things down. But I don’t keep tabs on how many each company has—just how many are affected by closures or site limits.
